The base of the bookcase in the bottom left corner appears to melt into the foreground surface. The geometric lines of the plinth/base are distorted and lack clear definition, blending into the floor/wall texture.
The vertical line of the rightmost edge of the bookcase seems to waver slightly and does not align perfectly with the perspective of the rest of the room, suggesting minor geometric instability.

The text on the book spines is largely illegible gibberish or abstract patterns. While common in AI images, the complete lack of recognizable letterforms across all visible books is a strong indicator of generation artifacts.
